pairwise_assessment: Same activated B-cell label resolved by acute versus chronic activation-state emphasis.
paper_title_1: Single cell analysis of blood mononuclear cells stimulated through CD3 and CD28 shows collateral activation of B and NK cells and demise of monocytes
markers_1: CD38; PRDM1; TBX21; CD69; IL2RA; CD27; ITGAX; CXCR5; ICOS; TLR7
shared_markers: PRDM1; TBX21; CD27; ITGAX; CXCR5; TLR7
context_snippet_1: Indirect activation of NK cells via anti-CD3/CD28 activated 74 genes, most of which were shared with T cell responses including CD69, interferon stimulated/response, and cytotoxic genes. Scoring of single cells using different gene sets showed that activated NK cells had the highest scores for cytotoxicity whereas activated T cells had highest scores for senescence. Clustering and trajectory analyses revealed heterogeneity among activated NK and B cells. Late stage activated NK cells resembled previously described 'helper' NK cells and expressed CD83 protein (35), whereas late stage activated B cells expressed molecules that have been expressed in B cells associated with aging and auto-immune diseases (TLR7, PRDM1, ITGAX/CD11c, TBX21/T-bet) (39–41). Upon anti-CD3/CD28 treatment of PBMCs, B cells upregulated 383 genes and 4 cell surface proteins (CD69, CD25, ICOS, CD38) (Fig. 5A, Table S5).
paper_title_2: Single Cell Analysis of Blood Mononuclear Cells Stimulated Through Either LPS or Anti-CD3 and Anti-CD28
markers_2: PRDM1; TBX21; CD27; ITGAX; CXCR5; TLR7
context_snippet_2: Late stage activated NK cells resembled previously described "helper" NK cells and expressed CD83 protein ( 35 ), whereas late stage activated B cells expressed molecules that have been expressed in B cells associated with aging and auto-immune diseases ( TLR7, PRDM1, ITGAX /CD11c, TBX21 /T-bet) ( 39 – 41 ). However, compared to DN2s and ABCs, activated B cells retained follicular and conventional memory markers ( CXCR5 and CD27 ), likely as a reflection of acute vs. chronic activation.
interpretation_note_1: Shared activated B-cell program anchored by BLIMP1, CD11C, CD27, CXCR5, T-BET, and TLR7.
interpretation_note_2: Paper 1 adds CD25, ICOS/CD278, CD38, and CD69, indicating stronger acute activation.
interpretation_note_3: Paper 2 frames activated B cells relative to chronic/age-associated activation, whereas paper 1 includes additional acute activation markers.
